intro.h2: A small crew that stays close to every bathroom
paragraphs: Renovations & Dependable Building, also known as RenoDB, handles bathroom remodeling Blacksburg VA homeowners plan for, plus kitchens, basements and other spaces across the New River Valley. It is intentionally small. The company limits how many projects it runs at once, so Joey stays involved from planning and selections through the final walkthrough.

Bathrooms are the heart of the work: guest baths, primary suites and tubs swapped for walk-in showers in Blacksburg, Christiansburg and Riner. Prices are posted online from recent local jobs, and once the design is set you get a fixed price and a defined scope. Reviewers mention prompt replies, crews that show up when scheduled and a tidy job site.

services.h2: Remodeling services across the New River Valley

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Guest baths, primary suites and full layout changes, from tile, cabinetry and lighting to waterproofing and shower glass. Licensed plumbers and electricians join when required. Posted starting prices: $12,500 for a small bath, $24,000 for a mid-size bath and $46,000 for a large primary suite.

image.alt: Large walk-in shower with marble-look tile, built-in bench, grab bar and handheld shower in a Blacksburg primary bath

items.name: Kitchen Renovations
items.blurb: Layout planning, cabinetry, countertops, tile, lighting and appliance installation, managed as one plan with trusted local trade partners. Kitchens start at $55,000 for a small space, $85,000 for a mid-size kitchen with an island, and $125,000 for a large kitchen.

image.alt: Preston Forest kitchen remodel in Blacksburg with white shaker cabinets, stained wood island, marble-look counters and tile backsplash

items.name: Aging in Place Updates
items.blurb: Features that keep a home easy to use for years, built into projects you already want: walk-in showers with benches and grab bars, wider walkways and better lighting. In Pembroke, a new two-level deck was built with an accessible ramp alongside a kitchen remodel.

image.alt: Two-level covered wood deck with an accessible ramp on a 1919 Sears kit house in Pembroke, VA

items.name: Basement Remodeling
items.blurb: Unfinished or underused basements turned into guest areas, home offices, recreation rooms or a bar. The space is planned to feel connected to the rest of the house, and recent work includes a basement craft and hobby room in Radford.

image.alt: Finished basement bar with corrugated metal bar front, wood stools, barn door and stair to the main floor

items.name: Three-Season Rooms
items.blurb: Covered outdoor rooms with screened openings and flexible windows that stretch the outdoor season. In Blacksburg, an underused space beneath a deck became a quiet retreat with warm pine finishes, flexible windows and peaceful garden views.

image.alt: Blacksburg three-season room with knotty pine ceiling and walls, ceiling fans and tall black-framed windows facing the garden

why_choose_us.h2: Why Blacksburg and Christiansburg homeowners pick RenoDB

items.title: Prices before you call
items.text: The pricing guide lists starting costs for small, mid-size and large bathrooms and kitchens, based on recent jobs in the area. After design, you get a fixed price and a defined scope.

items.title: One point of contact
items.text: RenoDB works with the same vetted plumbers, electricians, tile setters and cabinet specialists project after project, and you deal with one person who coordinates them all.

items.title: Clean, respectful job sites
items.text: Drop cloths, shoe covers and daily clean-ups are standard. One Google reviewer said the crews showed up when scheduled and the project area was kept very neat and tidy.

items.title: Everything in one portal
items.text: Your JobTread customer portal holds updates, photos, estimates, change orders and invoices. You can sign proposals and make payments there without chasing emails.

about.h2: Meet Joey Ritenour and Ginny Ayers
about.text: Joey Ritenour is the owner and lead general contractor, with eight years of hands-on remodeling and construction experience. Before remodeling, he worked at Virginia Tech in hazardous materials management and lab inspection, which shaped his focus on safety and careful planning. He is a Virginia Tech graduate and a longtime member of the New River Valley community. Operations manager Ginny Ayers, who spent 14 years in Virginia Tech Alumni Relations, runs client communication, marketing and the systems behind each job.

image.alt: Joey Ritenour, owner of Renovations and Dependable Building in Blacksburg, VA

steps.title: 10-minute discovery call
steps.text: Book a short call online or call or text Joey. You talk through your goals, timeline and whether RenoDB is the right fit.

steps.title: In-home consultation
steps.text: Joey visits to review your space, walk through ideas and budget, and outline the next steps for your project.

steps.title: Design and finalize
steps.text: Layouts and selections are settled with design partners such as Reico Kitchen & Bath and DeHart Tile Co., then you receive a fixed price and defined scope.

steps.title: Build and deliver
steps.text: A dedicated team manages construction, keeps the jobsite clean and posts updates to your JobTread portal as work moves forward.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: When the work is complete, you walk through everything together to make sure it meets your expectations before the job is closed out.

service_area.h2: Towns we serve in the New River Valley
service_area.text: RenoDB works throughout the New River Valley. Recent projects include primary baths in Blacksburg, Christiansburg and Riner, a basement hobby room in Radford, a guest bath in Christiansburg's Highland Park, and a 1919 Sears kit house kitchen in Pembroke. Pulaski and Shawsville are on the service list too. The company is now scheduling for late winter and early spring of 2027.

faq.h2: Bathroom remodeling Blacksburg VA questions, answered

items.q: How much does a bathroom remodel cost in the New River Valley?
items.a: RenoDB's pricing guide is based on its most recent local jobs. A small bathroom under 50 square feet starts at $12,500. A mid-size full bath of 50 to 80 square feet starts at $24,000. A large primary suite over 100 square feet, with room for a soaking tub and walk-in shower, starts at $46,000.

items.q: Will I know the final price before work starts?
items.a: Yes. Layouts, materials and finishes are settled during design, before construction begins. With that detailed plan in place, RenoDB gives you a fixed price and a defined scope of work. If you have a firm budget, share it up front so the team can suggest options that fit it.

items.q: Can you replace my tub with a walk-in shower?
items.a: Yes. Replacing an outdated tub with a walk-in shower is one of the bathroom projects RenoDB lists. In the Wyatt Farms bathroom in Blacksburg, an unused soaking tub made way for a spacious walk-in shower with Blue Onyx accent tile, a coordinating blue vanity and custom rolling glass.

items.q: How will I know what is happening during the project?
items.a: Every client gets a JobTread customer portal. It shows real-time updates, documents and photos, and holds estimates, change orders and invoices in one place. You can review and sign proposals and pay invoices there, and Joey remains your main point of contact the whole way through.

items.q: How do I get started, and when can you begin?
items.a: Schedule a 10-minute discovery call online, or call or text Joey at (540) 418-2130. You will get an email to pick a time, then a 10 to 15 minute call about your goals and timeline. The company is currently scheduling projects for late winter and early spring of 2027.

final_cta.h2: Talk with Joey about your bathroom
final_cta.text: Call or text (540) 418-2130, or book a 10-minute discovery call to see if RenoDB is the right fit for your home.
